---
name: Idea
about: Something that would make this better
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve for a cuber?**
Not the feature — the problem. "I cannot tell which OLL cases cost me time" is
useful. "Add a graph" is harder to act on.

**How would you know it worked?**
What would change for you.

**Anything it must not do**
This project refuses to state things it cannot demonstrate, and will not add
retention mechanics that pressure people rather than help them improve. Worth
saying up front if your idea brushes against that.
